items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: I was playing with Cliff Jackson and his crazy cats at the Capitol Palace on Lenox Avenue.

ctx.x: Jimmy Newton was in Chicago at that time. Did you ever work with Jimmy Newton? No, I never worked with him. He never did use me. I don't know why. How long were you in Chicago?

Right. Well, just like I told you, I went there in 29. I stood there a while and traveled in and out. Then came back. All again, I stayed in Chicago for 13 years. Did you ever get to New York to do any musicians? Yeah. I played in New York before... I went to New York before I went to Chicago. I went to New York in 26. I was playing with Cliff Jackson and his crazy cats at the Capitol Palace on Lenox Avenue. What was the personnel of that band, do you recall? Well, it's kind of hard. I'd have to look it up, you…
